# Model benchmark notes (scraped, unstructured)

Amazon Nova Lite scored 38% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified (SWE-agent harness by
Princeton), at roughly $0.06 per million tokens, with a 300k-token context window.
Measured 2026-01-20.

Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.x reportedly hits 45% pass@1 on the same SWE-bench
